title: The Jester Prince
content:
[[File:Matejko_Stańczyk.jpg|thumb|400px|Matejko Stańczyk]]A member (perhaps the only one) of the [[royal family of Gore]].

A mule, blood brother to the Prince, lives on a plateau ([[08.15]])

According to [[Lady Natala]]'s lady in waiting, the lady in waiting's child with the Jester Prince was passed by [[stirges|stirge]] to Lady Natala, who claims it is the illegitimate son of the [[Duke of Thring]].
